subject: Application Adoption — CSM → Implementation: SDK gateway & endpoint migration
messages:
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@languora.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@languora.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — SDK gateway and endpoint migration plan

Hi Emily / Marco,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to get Languora onto Redwood for production inference. Per our call, I'm looping in Laura (implementation lead) and Monica (CSM) so we can convert the discovery notes into a clear adoption plan.

Quick summary of what we agreed:
- Start with sandbox SDK integration (server-side Java/Go) and run against our hosted API.
- Migrate from your current single-endpoint setup to the new gateway-based routing for region-aware fallbacks.
- Aim for a low-risk cutover: shadow traffic for 48 hours, then incremental 5–10% traffic ramp.

Attachments: migration-checklist.xlsx (high level timeline), sdk-quickstart-samples.zip (client snippets).

Action items for this thread:
1) Laura — confirm implementation staffing and an initial cutover window (2-business-day options).
2) Languora — share the current production request profile (avg tokens per request, peak RPS).
3) Monica — compile the rollout comms and escalation contacts.

I'll kick off the runbook doc link once Laura confirms.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

---

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@languora.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.ai>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@languora.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Mar 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — SDK gateway and endpoint migration plan

Thanks Vivek — tagging onto this thread with staffing and initial timeline.

We can assign a single implementation engineer + architect for the sprint:
- Implementation lead: Laura Bennett (me) — rollout owner and cutover approver.
- Engineer: Samir Patel (impl) — will be your primary technical point.

Proposed windows (pick one):
- Option A: Tue/Mar 26 — sandbox integration starts; shadow cutover Thu/Apr 4.
- Option B: Mon/Apr 1 — sandbox integration starts; shadow cutover Wed/Apr 10.

I reviewed the checklist and added a tech section for endpoint migration. Before we lock a window, can you confirm expected peak RPS and any existing retry/timeout rules you have today? That will determine the sizing and our suggested default timeouts.

I'll prepare a short runbook for the team and include a sample SDK snippet for token-preserving retries.

—Laura
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

---

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@languora.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@languora.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Mar 2029 13:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — SDK gateway and endpoint migration plan

Hi Laura, Vivek — thanks. A few quick answers from product/infra:
- Peak RPS (current): 120 requests/sec during peak windows, median 18 RPS.
- Avg tokens/request (prompt + expected completion): ~240 tokens.
- Current client-side retry: 3 retries, exponential backoff starting at 200ms, socket timeout 8s.

We're comfortable starting with Option A (Mar 26). Can you confirm the recommended client re-try policy and the exact endpoints we should target in sandbox vs prod? Also happy to run a pre-cutover load test; Marco can coordinate.

Thanks,
Emily Zhao
Head of Product, Languora Inc.

---

From: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@languora.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2029 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — SDK gateway and endpoint migration plan

Laura / team — thanks for the clear plan and sample code. Confirmed: we will run the sandbox load test on Mar 27 (Marco -> will send calendar invite) and target shadow on Apr 4.

A few quick notes from infra:
- We'll start with your recommended timeouts. If the 15s read timeout causes any client-level churn, we'll escalate back to you with request traces.
- Attachment request: could you add an example curl + raw HTTP body for the gateway POST (so our ops can validate WAF rules)?

I'll upload our RPS traces to the shared runbook link. Please include Samir on the technical walkthrough invite.

Best,
Marco Ruiz
Platform Engineer, Languora Inc.
